_help: Fix how rooms look. Save, then press F5 in Legend3D.
Room entries are keyed by vnum (shown in the Godot output when you enter a room).
props: a list like [{"type": "hearth", "at": "on the north wall"}, {"type": "table", "many": true}]
no_auto_props: true to ignore the description and use only your props
floor_mode (outdoors): none | strips | full; floor, boundary, boundary_h, int_floor
Prop types: hearth table stool counter barrel crate shelf bed lantern torch candle tapestry fur
cauldron well fountain tree bush stone statue altar chest board mailbox cart stall door
Textures: stone plaster wood beams dirt grass cobble hedge rock sand water thatch wattle daub
drystone timber darktimber earth iron cloth hearthstone
Area entries (under areas, keyed by area name) override that area's style pack,
